description:
"Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7125|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3150|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink."
